name: GoDaddy — Domains & DNS
description: Pull domain registrations and DNS records from GoDaddy to discover all authoritative DNS records and domain expiry dates for takeover risk assessment

steps.instruction: Go to developer.godaddy.com and sign in with your GoDaddy account
Navigate to API Keys and click 'Create New API Key'. Select 'Production' environment.
Copy the API Secret (shown only once after creation)

validation_request.error_message: Could not connect to GoDaddy API. Verify your API key and secret are for the Production environment.

transform.expr: {'hostname': (record.get('name', '') + '.' + record.get('_domain', '') if record.get('name', '') != '@' else record.get('_domain', '')), 'fqdn': (record.get('name', '') + '.' + record.get('_domain', '') if record.get('name', '') != '@' else record.get('_domain', '')), 'ip': record.get('data', ''), 'display_name': (record.get('name', '') + '.' + record.get('_domain', '') if record.get('name', '') != '@' else record.get('_domain', ''))}

{'dns_record_type': record.get('type', ''), 'ttl': record.get('ttl'), 'domain': record.get('_domain', ''), 'domain_expiry': record.get('_domain_expiry', ''), 'nameservers': record.get('_nameservers', []), 'registrar_status': record.get('_registrar_status', ''), 'registrar': 'godaddy'}

domain.description: Domain name to pull DNS records for (e.g., 'example.com')

record_type.description: Filter by record type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT). Leave blank for all.
